productivity_method.series: Observed starting NDVI before edits, followed by annual model outputs. Not historical observations.
productivity_method.trajectory: Linear slope and pinned Mann–Kendall 95% table through 60 samples; longer series use a continuity-corrected normal approximation with conservative untied variance. Available from 10 annual samples. Statistical significance describes the synthetic series, not forecast confidence.
productivity_method.state: Fixed first 10 samples (2021–2030) versus latest 3 non-overlapping samples; available from 2033. Extended baseline percentiles, ±2 class threshold, 0.01 NDVI deadband.
productivity_method.performance: Mean over the elapsed simulation / scene-local 90th percentile for the same initial dominant land cover; ≤0.5 declines. Groups stay fixed, benchmarks use the same elapsed period. No soil taxonomy; any open-water history and nonpositive benchmarks unknown.
productivity_method.initial_policy: Before 13 annual samples, combined productivity is assumed stable for cells with valid NDVI and a positive terrestrial comparison benchmark. Component scores remain calculated or unavailable. From 13 samples, use calculated productivity. Missing inputs and open-water history remain unknown.
productivity_method.limitations: Initial stability is a simulation assumption, not observed historical stability. Scenario adaptation, not identical Trends.Earth outputs. Early interventions affect the simulated reference period. No historical NDVI is invented; no local ecological validation.

quantity_maps.vegetation: Scenario NDVI, displayed -0.1 to 0.8 with endpoint saturation
quantity_maps.soil_carbon: Scenario stock density, t C/ha, displayed 0 to 120 with endpoint saturation
quantity_maps.time: 2046, compared against 2021 baseline and intervening simulated years for assessment

meaning: Hypothetical tree-to-built edit in western SF; calculated with existing application model. Not observed degradation or an actual proposal. Performance is a productivity submetric, never substituted for combined productivity. Incomplete non-declining cells stay gray.
